name: Conformity
overview: Scripture warns believers against conforming to the patterns and practices of ungodly societies, as seen in commands not to follow the multitude to do evil or adopt the customs of Egypt and Canaan (Exodus 23:2; Leviticus 18:3). The godly are called to avoid walking in the counsel of the wicked or standing in the way of sinners, instead walking in the law of the Lord with sincerity and prudence (Psalms 1:1; Psalms 119:1; Proverbs 14:15). Jesus further reminds His followers that opposition from the world is to be expected, as the world hated Him first (John 15:18), underscoring the call to remain distinct and faithful amidst cultural pressures.
